title: RuleForge
description: Advanced Server Control: Ban Recipes & Dimensions with Timers, GUIs, and Timezone Support.
body:
# 🛡️ RuleForge - Advanced Server Control
**By Ray Industries**

Take full control of your SMP or Network. RuleForge allows server administrators to dynamically ban **Recipes** and **Dimensions** with precision. Whether you need to disable the Mace for a week or close the End dimension until an event starts, RuleForge handles it with style.

## ✨ Key Features

### 🔨 Recipe Control
* **Ban Any Item:** Instantly prevent the crafting of any item.
* **Smart Detection:** Blocks vanilla crafting, 2x2 inventory crafting, and automation.
* **Interactive Feedback:** Players trying to craft banned items see a custom Barrier with the unban date.

### 🌍 Dimension Manager
* **Lock Worlds:** Close the Nether, End, or custom dimensions.
* **Secure:** Blocks portals and teleport commands.
* **Immersive:** Custom sounds and titles when players try to enter.

### ⏳ Time & Date System
* **Timed Unbans:** Set bans to expire automatically (e.g., "In 3 Days" or "On Dec 31st").
* **Timezone Support:** Supports real-world timezones (IST, EST, UTC, etc.) for accurate event planning.
* **Admin GUI:** Toggle settings and manage duration cycles purely via an in-game GUI.

### ⚙️ Admin Tools
* **GUI Panel:** Type `/ruleforge` to open the Control Panel.
* **Ban Item in Hand:** Hold an item and click one button to ban it.
* **Status Dashboard:** See active bans at a glance.
* **Tab Completion:** Full auto-completion for items and worlds.

---

## 🚀 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/ruleforge` | Opens the Admin GUI Panel | `ruleforge.admin` |
| `/banrecipe <item> [time]` | Bans a crafting recipe | `ruleforge.ban.recipe` |
| `/unbanrecipe <item>` | Unbans a recipe | `ruleforge.ban.recipe` |
| `/bandimension <world> [time]` | Locks a dimension | `ruleforge.ban.dimension` |
| `/unbandimension <world>` | Unlocks a dimension | `ruleforge.ban.dimension` |

### 🕒 Time Format Examples
* **Permanent Ban:** `/banrecipe mace`
* **Specific Date:** `/banrecipe mace 2025-12-31 18:00 IST`

---

## 🔧 Installation
1.  Download `RuleForge.jar`.
2.  Drag it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3.  Restart the server.
4.  Enjoy full control!

**Supports:** Paper, Spigot, Purpur (1.21+)
